content_sections.heading: STPI Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Separate qualification and service conditions apply for candidates applying through the Absorption route; these are detailed post-wise in the official notification. Age relaxation is applicable as per Government of India rules for candidates already working in Government/STPI on a regular basis, and for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates. Age is reckoned as on the closing date, 12 October 2026. Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

rows.essential_qualification_experience: Graduate with 6 years’ experience in personnel/administration/vigilance, OR Postgraduate with 4 years’ experience in the same field. Desirable: Diploma in Personnel/Financial/Purchase Management, or MBA with 1 year experience in Personnel/Administration/Vigilance.
3-year Diploma in Electronics/Computer Science/IT/Telecommunication OR Bachelor in Electronics/Computer Science/Computer Application/IT OR DOEACC ‘A’ level certificate, with 2 years’ experience.
Same academic qualification as MTSS ES-V (Diploma/Bachelor/DOEACC ‘A’ level), with 1 year’s experience.
Graduate in any discipline from a recognised University. Desirable: 6-month certification course in Computer Operations.
Matriculate or equivalent. Desirable: Knowledge of typing, computer operation and operating photocopying/fax machine, tea/coffee maker, etc.

content_sections.heading: STPI Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Candidates have to pay an application fee of Rs. 500/- per application. No fee is required from female candidates and candidates belonging to SC/ST/PH category. The fee, once paid, is non-refundable. The exact mode and process of payment is specified on the online application portal at www.stpi.in .

content_sections.heading: STPI Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: Pay is as per the 7th Central Pay Commission Pay Matrix applicable to each post, ranging from Level 1 (Rs. 18,000-56,900) for Office Attendant up to Level 7 (Rs. 44,900-142,400) for Administrative Officer. The notification does not specify additional allowances separately; these would be as per applicable Government/STPI rules.

content_sections.heading: STPI Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for all posts is through a Written Examination; candidates for Office Attendant (S-I) must additionally clear a Skill Test. Only screened-in candidates (based on the completed online application) are called for the written exam. There is negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer. Minimum qualifying marks for final selection/merit are 50% for General category, 45% for OBC, 40% for SC/ST, with an additional 5% relaxation for PWD candidates in their respective category. Examination centres are Delhi/NCR and Bengaluru. The detailed syllabus is provided as Annexure-I of the official notification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for STPI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official STPI website, www.stpi.in . No other mode of application is accepted. Complete the online application form carefully, filling all essential steps. Candidates working in Central/State Government/PSUs/Autonomous Organisations should keep a copy of the NOC issued by their employer ready to submit at the time of applying. Upload caste/category certificates (in the prescribed Central Government format) if claiming reservation or age relaxation. Pay the applicable application fee online, where applicable. Submit the completed application before the closing date of 12 October 2026. Candidates applying for more than one post must submit separate applications with the requisite fee for each. The STPI Recruitment 2026 Apply Online link will be available on the official website, www.stpi.in , during the application window from 29 August 2026 to 12 October 2026. Only fully completed applications submitted online by the closing date will be considered for screening.

content_sections.heading: Other Important Points
content_sections.text: Appointment on Direct Recruitment/Absorption basis carries a probation period of two years. Selected candidates are liable to be posted at any STPI centre. Candidates are advised to ensure the accuracy of their category claim, as unsupported claims will lead to cancellation of candidature. Canvassing in any form will make the candidature liable for rejection. Any litigation arising from this recruitment is subject to the jurisdiction of Delhi courts.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for STPI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the STPI recruitment is 12 October 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in STPI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 10 vacancies are announced for various posts including Administrative Officer, Member Technical Support Staff, Assistant, and Office Attendant. Please refer to the detailed vacancy breakdown in the article.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for STPI posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification varies by post. For Office Attendant, Matriculation is required. For other posts, qualifications range from Graduation to Post Graduation, Diplomas, and specific certifications like DOEACC 'A' level.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for STPI recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts is 40 years. Age relaxation will be provided to eligible candidates as per the Government of India rules and regulations.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for STPI recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/- for General and OBC category candidates. SC/ST and Women candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for STPI jobs?
faq.answer: The selection process for STPI recruitment typically involves a written examination followed by a skill test. Candidates are advised to prepare thoroughly for both stages.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for STPI posts?
faq.answer: The salary structure for the STPI posts ranges from Rs. 18,000 to Rs. 142,400 per month, depending on the post and the corresponding pay level as per the 7th Central Pay Commission.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from any state apply for STPI recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates from any state in India can apply for the STPI recruitment provided they meet the eligibility criteria. The job location is mentioned as New Delhi, Delhi.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for the STPI recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates must apply online through the official STPI website. The application process involves filling out the online form, uploading necessary documents, and paying the application fee if applicable.
